Description: Time series of volumetric soil moisture at Marquardt study area, retrieved from Profile Probes and Theta Probes

Provider.Name: Till Francke
Provider.Institution: University of Potsdam, Environmental Sciences & Geography

Citation.Info: These files are part of the dataset published along with the data paper mentioned below.
Citation.cite-as: Heistermann, M., Francke, T., Scheiffele, L., Dimitrova Petrova, K., Budach, C., Schrön, M., Trost, B., Rasche, D.,  Güntner, A.,Döpper, V., Förster, M., Köhli, M., Angermann, L., Antonoglou, N., Zude-Sasse, M. and Oswald, S.: Three years of soil moisture observations by a dense cosmic-ray neutron sensing cluster at an agricultural research site in north-east Germany, Earth Syst. Sci. Data, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2023-19, 2023

Further technical details: Time series of soil moisture from permittivity (see epsilon_series_meta.json) measured with PR2-profile probes and ThetaProbes.
The column names hold the depth of the respective sensors below ground in cm, e.g. theta40 is the volumetric soil moisture (m3/m3) at a depth of 40 cm.

internal remark 1 (#Mq_profile): converted to volumetric soil moisture theta using R-package FDR2soilmoisture, version 0.154: bulk density, clay fraction and organic matter content interpolated to all locations using Kriging on coefficients of bilinear approximated profiles. epsilon-theta-relationship trained on ThetaProbe- and gravimetric data, tested on PR2-data; used equation: theta_Zhao_adj (Zhao et. 2016 with adjusted coefficients)

internal remark 2 (#Mq_ThetaProbe): conversion to theta using R-package FDR2soilmoisture, version 0.161: trained on ThetaProbe-data, tested on PR2-data; used equation: theta_Zhao_adj (Zhao et. 2016 with adjusted coefficients) r2_train_ex=0.574421605379561; r2_test=-0.20296304125331

internal remark 3: the time series permittivity (epsilon) measured with TDR100 probes was converted to volumetric soil moisture according to the manufacturers' recommendation, i.e. using the equation after Topp et al. (1980): theta = -5.3*10^-2+2.92*10^-2*epsilon+-5.5*10^-4*epsilon^2+4.3*10^-6*epsilon^3
